decision: 5 second time penalty. (5 seconds added to elapsed Race time).
fact: Car 87 was released in an unsafe manner into the path of Car 16.
offence: Breach of Article B1.6.2a of the FIA F1 Regulations.
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 87 (Oliver Bearman), the driver of Car 16 (Charles Leclerc), team representatives and reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video, and in-car video evidence. BEA was released from its pit stop into the path of LEC, which was already proceeding along the pit lane. As a result, LEC was forced to brake and take evasive action, being squeezed towards the pit wall on the right-hand side. The Stewards determined that BEA was released in an unsafe manner and therefore imposed a 5 second time penalty.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 87 Unsafe Release
